progressPolicy.reason: The existing static site has no suitable authenticated backend for secure child-profile sync
progressPolicy.restoreRequirement: A parent must keep an exported progress file to restore after browser data is cleared. Browser storage and PWA installation are not backups.
progressPolicy.migration: Former shared stage work belongs only to the previously active profile. Existing separate legacy paths remain intact; an original pre-migration local copy is retained where possible.
progressPolicy.import: Validate before mutation; restore missing work and union completion/history without silently replacing conflicting existing activity state

limitations: Physical Android/iPhone/iPad Home Screen installation and OS-level touch behaviour were not verified; viewport and touch tests used headless Edge

Human pronunciation and clarity need parent listening: English names and phonics, especially vowels/Q/X, brisk and slower spelling, Bangla meanings/pronunciation helpers and story explanations; Arabic phrase needs a competent Arabic listener
Arabic phrase and Bengali explanation use whole-phrase highlighting where reliable individual word cues are unavailable
Offline audio includes previously played clips only, with a 300-clip cache limit
Short screens and enlarged text may require vertical scrolling; no unintended horizontal scrolling was found
Fluency correctness is parent-observed, not automatic speech recognition or independent-reading mastery
No App Store or Play Store publication; no new or replaced recordings
